corpus_stability.reason: The Kentucky Driver Manual is a single-issuer handbook corpus with no signal of revisions more than once per year.

ranked.label: Eighty percent written test on rules, procedures, and signs
Vision gates the written before any permit
Permit holds and practice logs by age
Intermediate curfew, passengers, and zero tolerance
Road scoring with instant fails and weekly retries
Renewal windows with restart past five years
Point bands with hearings and suspension ladders
Basic Class D against commercial classes

market_signal.origin_note: market signal is authored in part E

items.why: Licensing rules and test procedures are declarative recall served by standard flashcards and quizzes; no separate practice mode is needed.

sections.heading: C — The Driver's License
sections.markdown:
## C — The Driver's License

FACT_ID: sec01-F01 | anchor: A01
Class D is the basic operator license most drivers carry, Class E covers mopeds only, Class M covers motorcycles, and Classes A through C are commercial [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F02 | anchor: A01
Class A spans combinations above 26,001 pounds, Class B spans single vehicles at 26,001-plus towing 10,000 or less, and Class C spans lighter hazmat or 16-plus-passenger vehicles [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F03 | anchor: A01
CDL rules reach volunteers such as church and school bus drivers, yet spare private cars, military and rescue rigs, campers, and farm trucks within 150 miles of home [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F04 | anchor: A02
Class D wants 15-year-old residents with parents signing below 18 plus three passed tests, while duty military, licensed dependents, working nonresidents, and farm rigs skip licensing and the under-15, suspended, incompetent, unsafe, or English-illiterate are barred [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F05 | anchor: A02
Mopeds capped at 2 horsepower, 50 cubic centimeters, automatic shifting, and 30 miles per hour need 16-year-old credentialed riders, or a Class E earned through knowledge and vision tests alone [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F06 | anchor: A03
Moped riders should ride lit with a wide cushion, are urged toward helmets without a mandate, and must shun highways posted above 30 miles per hour [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F07 | anchor: A03
Motorcycles seat riders astride at most three wheels with minibikes demanding full credentials on roads and private land alone excusing the unlicensed, while permits serve intermediate holders and adults at regional offices toward a held permit, a State Police road test, and a fee or a RideSmartKY certificate [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F08 | anchor: A04
Rider-course graduates skip motorcycle tests and may upgrade expired permits, while all applicants file at 15-plus with intact privileges before State Police vision, written, permit, and road-test sequencing that ends at the written for mopeds [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F09 | anchor: A04
Under-18 applicants need a parent or guardian to accept joint liability by signing at the test site beside a birth certificate or court guardianship papers [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F10 | anchor: A05
Teens climb three phases, permit then intermediate then full license, and a parent may withdraw responsibility anytime to cancel the credential [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F11 | anchor: A05
Permit seekers show a birth certificate, Social Security card, residency proof doubled for REAL ID, a school compliance form, and a signed parent, with photocopies refused [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F12 | anchor: A05
Passing buys an under-21 permit held 180 days with a 60-hour log counting 10 at night, driven only beside a licensed adult 21-plus with one young unrelated passenger and no midnight-to-6-a.m. trips under 18 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F13 | anchor: A06
Drivers under 21 meet zero alcohol tolerance at .02, see any moving or permit violation restart the 180-day clock, and risk suspension past 6 points as minors [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec01-F14 | anchor: A06
After 180 days and turning 17, teens book a State Police road test with an insured registered vehicle, a signed 60-hour log, and a week-fresh eligibility letter, never driving themselves there, with failure costing a week [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec01-F15 | anchor: A06
Passing earns an intermediate sticker toward a full license after 180 more days plus driver education at 17, under a lasting midnight-to-6-a.m. curfew [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec01-F16 | anchor: A07
Intermediates under 18 keep the one-young-passenger cap, zero tolerance, violation restarts, and the 6-point suspension tripwire [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec01-F17 | anchor: A07
Full licensure follows the course, 180 days, and age 17 at a regional office with a paper temporary, and training must finish by 19 through free classroom, $12.50 online, high school, or a private 4-hour course [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec01-F18 | anchor: A08
Some course completions self-report within two business days, while the rest travel by mail to Frankfort carrying license number, name, and birth date [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec01-F19 | anchor: A08
Drivers 18 to 20 book State Police written and vision tests with four document types in original, then hold a three-year paper permit 180 days beside a 21-or-older companion before the road test [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec01-F20 | anchor: A09
Road tests want insured registered cars with adult escorts and punish misses with a week, while drivers 21-plus repeat the same papers and tests with only a 30-day hold [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec01-F21 | anchor: A10
First-timers need 20/40 vision with required lenses as a restriction and a 20/60 floor after specialist referral, then face a license-matched written test on rules, procedures, and signs from this manual [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec01-F22 | anchor: A11
Operators must score at least 80 percent to pass the written test, which also runs orally, on tablets, and across many languages [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-F23 | anchor: A11
Examiners inspect registration, insurance, lights, signals, horn, wipers, and brakes, then ride the clean front passenger seat belted through normal traffic with no tricks and no in-car interpreter [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-F24 | anchor: A12
Test cars need 350-foot high beams, 100-foot lows, a 500-foot red taillight, working lamps, a lit legible plate, clear glass with a wiper, horn, muffler, mirrors, and steering, with missing or illegal gear canceling the test [A12].
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec01-F25 | anchor: A13
The road test grades stops, backing, turnarounds, hills, parking, intersections, clutch, speed, turns, lanes, right-of-way, and control, fails instantly on crashes or violations, drops drivers after two ignored instructions, reports only pass or fail, and enforces a week before retry [A13].
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec01-F26 | anchor: A13
All State Police testing runs appointment-only online with slots opening weekdays at 8 a.m. roughly three weeks out, and anyone needing interpreters or aid must phone the site first [A13].
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec01-F27 | anchor: A14
New residents must license within 30 days, testing only when long expired or lost behind a certified record, and file residency, presence, Social Security, and old-license papers while out-of-state permit holders swap permits first at 15-plus [A14].
Source: [A14 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec01-F28 | anchor: A14
College students keep valid home licenses beside a Kentucky school ID, non-citizens drive a year on foreign licenses with international permits under reciprocity, and permanent residents test from written-only to all three exams by permit origin [A14].
Source: [A14 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec01-F29 | anchor: A15
International-permit holders face anywhere from written-only to all three exams by residency and reciprocity, valid United States licenses excuse both resident classes, and the permit-less restart with a Kentucky permit [A15].
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec01-F30 | anchor: A15
Stationed troops may renew Class D licenses by mail, reclaim expired ones test-free within 90 days of return, and otherwise follow standard expired-license steps [A15].
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec01-F31 | anchor: A16
Under-21 licenses die 90 days after 21 while adult cards run 31 days past each birthday with six-month-early renewal, test-free below five years expired, four- or eight-year terms, and mail or office replacement [A16].
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec01-F32 | anchor: A16
Address or name changes demand a duplicate license within 10 days under citation threat, with one legal proof for names and an updated Social Security card displayed but never accepted as that proof [A16].
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec01-F33 | anchor: A17
Licenses fall to perjury, unlicensed driving, missing insurance, ignored courts, unpaid support, triple reckless years, DUI, test refusal, fleeing, hit-and-run, thefts, and vehicular manslaughter, while parents may cancel minors, drivers may surrender by form, and unpaid crash judgments suspend from 60 days [A17].
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec01-F34 | anchor: A17
Drivers start point-free, risk suspension at 12 points or 7 below 18 inside two years after a hearing, lose points after two years with five-year records, and skipping the hearing draws six months, then a year, then two [A17].
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec01-F35 | anchor: A18
Hearings may trade suspension for probation plus traffic school, unrepeatable within two years, and the school takes court-referred licensed drivers with minor violations at most yearly as a court order whose breach suspends [A18].
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec01-F36 | anchor: A18
Every DUI conviction demands a human-resources-cabinet assessment plus an approved program with fees paid before reinstatement, and reissue further needs the fee, the completion notice, and a served suspension [A18].
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0026]
